proof:
Notation: |α| := covectorEuclideanNorm α.
1. Claim: for every m ∈ ℕ and every m-form θ : ℝ^N → Covector (ℝ^N) m with IsTestForm θ (that is, ContDiff ℝ ∞ θ and HasCompactSupport θ) there is a ∈ ℝ with |θ(y)| ≤ a for all y.
(a) θ is continuous: ContDiff.continuous applied to the first component of IsTestForm θ.
(b) g := covectorEuclideanNorm ∘ θ is continuous. By definition, |α| = √(Σ_{I : Fin m → Fin N} (if StrictMono I then (α(fun i => e_{I i}))² else 0)), where e = EuclideanSpace.basisFun. Go through the pieces:
- For each fixed tuple v, y ↦ θ(y)(v) is continuous (Continuous.eval_const, via the ContinuousEvalConst instance of continuous alternating maps), and so is its square.
- The condition StrictMono I does not depend on y, so continuous_if_const applies; the else-branch is constant.
- A finite sum of continuous functions is continuous (continuous_finsetSum).
- Real.sqrt is continuous (Real.continuous_sqrt).
(c) g has compact support. Since covectorEuclideanNorm 0 = 0 (covectorEuclideanNorm_zero), HasCompactSupport.comp_left (with g := covectorEuclideanNorm) applied to HasCompactSupport θ gives HasCompactSupport g.
(d) A continuous compactly supported real function is bounded. Continuous.bounded_above_of_compact_support gives C with ‖g y‖ ≤ C for all y. Since g y ≤ |g y| = ‖g y‖ (le_abs_self, Real.norm_eq_abs), a := C works.
2. Apply the claim with m := k and θ := ω (IsTestForm ω is ω.property.1) to obtain a.
3. Apply the claim with m := k + 1 and θ := exteriorDerivative ω to obtain b. This θ is a test form by exteriorDerivative_isTestForm ω.property.1. □

Lean proof script. It compiled with lake env lean after import GMT.Ch07.Submission, inside namespace GMT.Ch07 with the contract's opens, and uses no interface. It is the tactic body of theorem Submission.cmcdt_lpo_pf_form_bounds : <lean_statement> := by
  intro N k ω
  have hbd : ∀ (m : ℕ) (θ : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) m), IsTestForm θ →
      ∃ a : ℝ, ∀ y, covectorEuclideanNorm (θ y) ≤ a := by
    intro m θ hθ
    have hθc : Continuous θ := hθ.1.continuous
    have hcont : Continuous (covectorEuclideanNorm ∘ θ) := by
      show Continuous fun y => covectorEuclideanNorm (θ y)
      unfold covectorEuclideanNorm
      refine Real.continuous_sqrt.comp (continuous_finsetSum _ fun I _ => ?_)
      exact continuous_if_const _ (fun _ => (hθc.eval_const _).pow 2) (fun _ => continuous_const)
    have hsupp : HasCompactSupport (covectorEuclideanNorm ∘ θ) :=
      HasCompactSupport.comp_left (g := covectorEuclideanNorm) hθ.2 (covectorEuclideanNorm_zero N m)
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hcont.bounded_above_of_compact_support hsupp
    refine ⟨C, fun y => (le_abs_self _).trans ?_⟩
    have := hC y
    rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
  exact ⟨hbd k _ ω.property.1, hbd (k + 1) _ (exteriorDerivative_isTestForm ω.property.1)⟩
